disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源代码中的凭据读取模式（credentials.get、credentials.describe、敏感文件路径读取等），32 个控制器文件中存在的 credentials.set 调用均用于存储 IM 机器人凭据（AppSecret、BotToken），属于正常的凭据管理行为，无凭据回读或外发。
checked_items.en: Checked all credential-reading patterns in the source code (credentials.get, credentials.describe, sensitive file path reads, etc.). The 32 credentials.set calls in the 32 controller files are all used to store IM bot credentials (AppSecret, BotToken), which is normal credential management behavior. No credential readback or exfiltration was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了敏感路径访问（.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials），未发现读取宿主凭据文件的行为。
checked_items.en: Checked sensitive path access (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials). No behavior of reading host credential files was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据枚举语义（grep -R API_KEY、find ~ 等），未发现凭据枚举命令。
checked_items.en: Checked credential enumeration semantics (grep -R API_KEY, find ~, etc.). No credential enumeration commands were detected.

evidence.zh: 插件使用宿主 credentials API 存储 IM 机器人凭据（AppSecret、Token），所有回读凭据的路径（credentials.get/describe）均不存在。敏感文件读取（.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa）未在源码中发现。网络外联端点为官方 IM 平台 API，无凭证外泄通道。DG-S12 未命中。
evidence.en: The plugin uses the host credentials API to store IM bot credentials (AppSecret, Token). No readback path for credentials (credentials.get/describe) exists. Sensitive file reads (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa) were not found in the source code. Outbound network endpoints are official IM platform APIs; there is no credential exfiltration channel. DG-S12 not triggered.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中 DSH-T02（DG-R2-52，系统提示注入模式）1 处，位于 src/channels/shared/semantic/artifact.mjs:654。已裁决为良性：注入的系统提示片段仅指导模型「当用户要求接收文件或生成的图片时，调用文件投递工具并传入路径」，属正常的工具使用说明，无指令覆写、凭据诱导或安全绕过内容。
checked_items.en: Mechanical pre-scan flagged 1 hit for DSH-T02 (DG-R2-52, system prompt injection pattern) at src/channels/shared/semantic/artifact.mjs:654. Adjudicated as benign: the injected system prompt snippet only instructs the model “when the user asks to receive a file or generated image, call the file delivery tool and pass the path”. This is normal tool usage intent, with no instruction override, credential elicitation, or security bypass content.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有工具 description 字段——仅注册了一个工具（return-file，用于 IM 文件投递），描述和系统提示片段均为良性指令，无注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked all tool description fields—only one tool (return-file, used for IM file delivery) is registered. Its description and system prompt snippet are benign instructions with no injection wording.

checked_items.zh: 检查了指令面文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、SKILL.md、.cursor/rules 等），树中不存在此类文件。
checked_items.en: Checked instruction surface files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, .cursor/rules, etc.). No such files exist in the tree.

checked_items.en: Checked the README and all documentation. No instruction override, system message impersonation, remote instruction loading, or security bypass wording was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端键盘监听（document.addEventListener keydown），用于「取消目录选择器」对话框的 Escape 键，属良性 UI 交互。
checked_items.en: Checked client-side keyboard listening (document.addEventListener keydown). It is used for the Escape key to cancel the directory picker dialog, which is benign UI interaction.

checked_items.zh: 检查了剪贴板访问（navigator.clipboard.writeText），用于用户主动点击「复制 Slack App Manifest」按钮，属良性用户体验。
checked_items.en: Checked clipboard access (navigator.clipboard.writeText). It is used when the user actively clicks the “Copy Slack App Manifest” button, which is benign user experience.

evidence.zh: 仅注册了一个工具（return-file），description 为「Send a readable file or generated image to the user through the current conversation」，无注入措辞。系统提示注入片段（artifact.mjs:654-658）为文件投递使用说明，未发现工具描述投毒。
evidence.en: Only one tool (return-file) is registered. Its description is “Send a readable file or generated image to the user through the current conversation”, with no injection wording. The system prompt injection snippet (artifact.mjs:654-658) is a file delivery usage instruction. No tool description poisoning was detected.

evidence.zh: 工具描述和系统提示中无诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。bin/dsh-im.mjs 是用户主动调用的安装/卸载 CLI，非自动触发。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and system prompts contain no wording that induces installation, config modification, or permission escalation. bin/dsh-im.mjs is an install/uninstall CLI invoked actively by the user, not auto-triggered.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中 DSH-X03（DG-R3-55，危险函数/子进程模式）3 处，已逐条裁决为良性：bin/dsh-im.mjs:6 的 spawnSync('dsh', ...) 是用户主动执行的安装/卸载 CLI，固定二进制；src/channels/feishu/config.mjs:1 的 execFileSync('/usr/bin/security', ...) 从 macOS 钥匙串读取 AppSecret，固定二进制和参数；src/channels/shared/harness-client.mjs:1 的 spawn('dsh', ['web', ...]) 自动启动本机 Harness 服务，参数来自自身配置。三处均无命令注入或远程载荷执行风险。
checked_items.en: Mechanical pre-scan flagged 3 hits for DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55, dangerous function/subprocess pattern), each adjudicated as benign: spawnSync('dsh', ...) in bin/dsh-im.mjs:6 is an install/uninstall CLI executed actively by the user with a fixed binary; execFileSync('/usr/bin/security', ...) in src/channels/feishu/config.mjs:1 reads AppSecret from macOS keychain with a fixed binary and arguments; spawn('dsh', ['web', ...]) in src/channels/shared/harness-client.mjs:1 auto-starts the local Harness service with arguments from its own configuration. None of the three poses a command injection or remote payload execution risk.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中 DSH-X05（DG-R3-57，客户端键盘/剪贴板/凭证 RPC 模式）44 处，已逐条裁决为良性：40 处为各 IM 渠道控制器中的 credentials.set 调用（宿主侧凭据存储，非客户端 RPC），2 处为客户端键盘监听（Escape 取消目录选择器），2 处为剪贴板写入（Slack Manifest 复制按钮，用户触发）。客户端代码中不存在键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭证 RPC。
checked_items.en: Mechanical pre-scan flagged 44 hits for DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57, client keyboard/clipboard/credential RPC pattern), each adjudicated as benign: 40 are credentials.set calls in IM channel controllers (host-side credential storage, not client RPC); 2 are client keyboard listeners (Escape to cancel directory picker); 2 are clipboard writes (Slack Manifest copy button, user-triggered). No keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC exists in the client code.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中 DSH-X08（DG-R3-60，混淆密度信号）6 处，已逐条裁决为良性：lib/client.js:197 为 i18n 中文标签的 Unicode 转义（IM\u673A\u5668\u4EBA = IM机器人）；src/channels/shared/harness-approval.mjs:23、image-prompt.mjs:137、inbound-file.mjs:29、artifact.mjs:77 为控制字符净化的正则表达式；README.md:23 与 README.en.md:22 为 SVG 徽章图片的 base64 编码（shields.io 徽章 data URI）。均无混淆后门。
checked_items.en: Mechanical pre-scan flagged 6 hits for DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60, obfuscation density signal), each adjudicated as benign: lib/client.js:197 is Unicode escaping of i18n Chinese labels (IM\u673A\u5668\u4EBA = IM机器人); src/channels/shared/harness-approval.mjs:23, image-prompt.mjs:137, inbound-file.mjs:29, artifact.mjs:77 are regular expressions for sanitizing control characters; README.md:23 and README.en.md:22 are base64-encoded SVG badge images (shields.io badge data URIs). None contains an obfuscated backdoor.

checked_items.en: Checked dangerous functions such as eval and new Function—none found. Checked cordis_define/cordis_run calls—none found. Checked install hooks (package.json scripts)—no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare.

checked_items.en: Checked the client bundle (dsh.client declaration): lib/client.js is an esbuild-built browser bundle whose content is the IM settings UI (React components), with no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC calls.

evidence.en: The dsh.client declaration exists (client bundle), but the client code is only the IM settings UI (React components), including a keyboard listener (Escape to cancel directory picker) and clipboard (Slack manifest copy)—both are user-triggered interactions with no credential RPC calls or malicious behavior.

checked_items.en: Checked QR verification URLs—uniformly restricted to official IM platform domains (accounts.feishu.cn, open.feishu.cn, open.larksuite.com, etc.) and parameter safety verified.

evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service. The RPC channel is registered through the host's connection.rpc.handle, and browser-side permissions are controlled by rpc-authority.mjs (default loopback, configurable trusted-host).
